Then reason: The question asks "What feeds on periwinkles?", that is, who feeds on periwinkles. According to the convention in a food web that arrows point from the organism being eaten to the eater, Periwinkles pointing to Snails indicates that Snails eat Periwinkles. Therefore the answer is snails.
